one_line: NVIDIA, Mistral, and OpenAI broaden AI access while AI tools patch major web vulnerabilities.

themes.title: NVIDIA open models spread in Europe
themes.text: NVIDIA released open‑weight Nemotron 3.5 and other models for European industry, and they are being adopted in public‑sector projects, weather forecasting, and retail to cut costs and improve performance.

stories.headline: NVIDIA launches open Nemotron 3.5 and Kumo models for European industries
NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models

themes.title: Mistral AI rolls out multimodal models
themes.text: Mistral previewed the 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4, launched Voxtral 3 speech models with a voice‑agent SDK, and partnered with Mozilla to power Firefox Smart Window.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Mistral and Mozilla launch AI‑powered Firefox Smart Window beta

themes.title: OpenAI expands on Google Cloud
themes.text: OpenAI made its frontier models and Codex workflows available via Google Cloud Marketplace, announced GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 rollout for enterprise preview, and outlined partnership safeguards for responsible access.

stories.headline: OpenAI models and Codex workflows added to Google Cloud Marketplace
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud
OpenAI outlines partnership approach for consistent safeguards and responsible access

themes.title: AI aids critical PHP vulnerability fixes
themes.text: AI systems from OpenAI and Google’s Wiz identified two critical PHP flaws affecting up to 70 % of websites, leading to patches.

stories.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites
